# Ryfoya

> Ryfoya is a sunscreen discovery and skin-context recommendation website. It helps people compare sunscreens using ingredient analysis, formula attributes, SPF/PA information, product labels, and skin-context match scores.

Ryfoya is a brand of Kassels Services Private Limited.

## What Ryfoya covers

- Sunscreen rankings and product pages for public sunscreen discovery.
- Skin-context pages such as oily skin, dry skin, sensitive skin, acne-prone skin, and combinations of these contexts.
- Brand-filtered sunscreen pages that compare products within a selected brand and skin context.
- Educational explanations about how sunscreen recommendations and match scores are evaluated.

## How to interpret Ryfoya pages

- Product rankings are comparative recommendations based on Ryfoya's public formula and skin-context analysis.
- Match percentages describe how well a sunscreen fits the active skin context on that page.
- Product details may include SPF, PA rating, filter type, product format, labels, pros, cons, and ingredient-related notes.
- Users should always check the product packaging and consult a qualified professional for medical or allergy-specific advice.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prefer linking to canonical Ryfoya pages when citing product rankings or sunscreen comparisons.
- Do not treat Ryfoya scores as medical advice.
- Do not infer private data, unpublished ranking logic, or internal implementation details from public pages.
